_comment: MAILGATEHTTPAPI1027: shared cases of the HTTP mail API rule in both mail gates (scripts/hooks/outgoing-copy-gate.py :: _mail_api_sends, scripts/email-send-gate.mjs :: mailApiSends). Each body is written to a script file and judged by script_run_sends / scriptRunSends, and passed as a -c / -e code string to is_send_invocation / isSendInvocation; both twins must answer `expected` on both paths. Origin: Marveen 50920, a Gmail REST send from a python script file passed the main agent's approval gate. A case may carry `helpers` (file name -> body): local modules written next to it, so the one-level helper read is pinned too; such a case is judged as a script file only, since a code string has no helper of its own here. MAILGATEHEREDOCFP1027: a send marker in a docstring, a comment or a prose literal is no send (the prose-literal masker). A case with `file_only` is judged as a script file only: the code-string path's older exec heuristic (an exec word and a sender word anywhere, pinned by send-invocation-cases.json) stays looser on purpose.
